metadata.note: Narrative display names shifted from mechanism to destination framing. Internal IDs unchanged for backward compatibility.

dollar_decline.description: Tracks the structural flight of global capital away from legacy reserve currencies toward hard assets, bilateral settlement frameworks, and alternative reserve architectures.

energy_sovereignty.description: Geopolitical strategy surrounding natural resources and the independence of national energy grids.

deglobalization.description: The physical reconstruction of domestic manufacturing capacity, automation infrastructure, and defense industrial bases as global supply chains fracture.

china_ascent.description: Strategic evaluation of China's economic and industrial trajectory against Western incumbents, and the emerging pan-Eurasian financial infrastructure.

space_economy.description: Commercialization of low-earth orbit, strategic militarization of the space domain, and the emergence of space as a theater of industrial competition.

gene_editing.description: The maturation of CRISPR technologies, systemic medical reshoring, and the multi-trillion-dollar restructuring of human lifespans and healthcare infrastructure.

tech_convergence.description: The fusion of AI, cloud infrastructure, and legacy software into unified enterprise intelligence stacks that concentrate market power.

wealthy_sports.description: The financialization of elite sports franchises, media rights, and cultural assets as private equity, hedge funds, and sovereign wealth vehicles.

ai_chips.description: The escalating race for compute dominance and the silicon supply chain as a cornerstone of national security and intelligence capability.

crypto_reserve.description: The integration of digital assets into institutional balance sheets, sovereign treasury reserves, and the emergence of non-sovereign liquidity rails.

rate_cycle.description: Central bank policy pivots, yield curve dynamics, and the interplay between liquidity conditions and inflationary risk across sovereign debt markets.

commodity_supercycle.description: Structural imbalances in raw material supply, fueled by energy transitions, long-term under-investment, and the physical repricing of scarce resources.
